pattern_explanation: The look-alike forms come from shared international vocabulary, but the meanings shifted in each language, so the words look close while the senses differ.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish verb 'kontrol etmek' (to check) looks like English 'control', and 'realize etmek' (to carry out) looks like English 'realize', which means 'to understand' in English. Do not translate these look-alikes by their form.
